summary: Preserved candidate PR 2737's UnifiedRadixCache L3 metrics and corrected the independently reviewed gaps: bounded L1/L2 transfer success and host-capacity failure counters, request-correlated L1/L2 lifecycle records in both cache implementations, and legacy HiRadixCache L3 request/token snapshots. Candidate PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2737. Review PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2827.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before counterexample: the exact candidate had no L1/L2 transfer-result metric API. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77fd2a1fe32e/evidence/before/counterexamples.log
17 passed after correction, including bounded cross-tier transfer labels and the preserved L3 delta/reset regressions. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77fd2a1fe32e/evidence/after/observability.log

4 passed on the assigned AMD GPU, exercising legacy HiRadixCache GPU-to-host completion and PP queue-drain behavior with the corrected instrumentation. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77fd2a1fe32e/evidence/after/hiradix.log

13 passed and 6 repository-gated skips on one AMD Instinct MI350X; actual file-backed L3 query, host staging, GPU load-back and K/V equality checks passed. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-77fd2a1fe32e/evidence/after/unified-gpu.log

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015; legacy and unified HiCache GPU tests passed as recorded above.
remaining_limitations: No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.

The new L1-to-L2 failure result covers the concrete synchronous host-capacity failure path. Unexpected asynchronous GPU transfer exceptions remain process errors rather than recoverable metric events.
Eviction-driven L1-to-L2 backups are cache-node lifecycle operations and do not always belong to one request, so they intentionally have aggregate metrics but no fabricated rid.

Mooncake, HF3FS, NIXL, UMBP, multi-node, TP/PP distributed, model-specific storage paths, and NVIDIA/CUDA were unavailable and remain unverified. No source changes were inferred from those unavailable paths.
The direct GPU regressions qualify cache transport and K/V round-trip equality, not HTTP serving, model semantic accuracy, or a different model architecture.
